discription: A resonant pulse wave synth with an ADSR envelope and a low-pass filter, suitable for leads or pads. It features controllable filter cutoff and resonance.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.01, decay=0.1, sustain=0.8, release=1.0, cutoff=2000, rq=0.5, pan=0;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = Pulse.ar(freq, 0.5);    var modulatedCutoff = cutoff + (LFSaw.kr(0.2).range(0, 500));    sig = RLPF.ar(sig, modulatedCutoff.clip(100, 15000), rq);    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan));}
